# General Practitioner (GP) Salary Australia 2026: What GPs Are Really Earning
## How much does a GP earn in Australia in 2026?
| State | 0-3 Years | 3-8 Years | 8+ Years |
|-|-|-|-|
| ACT | $295,000 | $320,000 | $350,000 |
| NSW | $295,000 | $320,000 | $370,000 |
| NT | $250,000 | $275,000 | $320,000 |
| QLD | $285,000 | $330,000 | $370,000 |
| SA | $230,000 | $290,000 | $350,000 |
| TAS | $230,000 | $280,000 | $360,000 |
| VIC | $245,000 | $300,000 | $390,000 |
| WA | $255,000 | $320,000 | $400,000 |

## Frequently asked questions
HCA’s 2026 data shows GP base earnings ranging from around $230,000 to $295,000 for GPs with 0-3 years’ experience, rising to $320,000-$400,000+ for GPs with 8 or more years’ experience, depending on the state.
